description: This file contains functions for masking and unmasking markdown content, using regular expressions to identify inline code, links, and URLs, and replacing them with placeholders for processing.

methods.name: maskMarkdown
methods.description: Masks markdown text by replacing inline code, links, and URLs with placeholders, updating the given mapping and placeholders list.

methods.name: maskMatches
methods.description: Helper function that finds matches with a regexp in text and replaces them with placeholders, updating the mapping and placeholders list.

methods.name: maskLinkURLs
methods.description: Finds URLs in markdown links within the text and replaces them with placeholders, updating the mapping and placeholders list.

methods.name: unmaskMarkdown
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in masked text with their original content based on the provided mapping.

methods.name: validatePlaceholders
methods.description: Checks that all placeholders are present in the text; returns an error if any are missing.
